sections: ClawQL is published as clawql-mcp on npm. The package ships bundled OpenAPI and Discovery specs under providers/ so discovery works offline—expect a large install (~90+ MB on disk) compared to a typical small CLI.
Requires Node.js 22+. The script runs npm install -g clawql-mcp when npm is available.
Registry tarballs are ~10 MB compressed; installed size is dominated by bundled specs.
After install, these commands are on your PATH (or use npx -p clawql-mcp <binary>):

| Command           | Purpose                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| clawql          | Onboarding CLI — onboard, init, doctor, secrets, mcp-config, sources, harness wrappers |
| clawql-mcp      | MCP server on stdio (Cursor, Claude Desktop, etc.)                                                                     |
| clawql-mcp-http | MCP over Streamable HTTP (PORT, /mcp, /healthz, /graphql)                                                      |
Point your MCP client at clawql-mcp on stdio (see MCP clients) or use the Agent setup prompt.
Docker: multi-stage image and stdio/compose notes live in the repo’s docker/README.md.
Remote MCP: PORT=8080 npx -p clawql-mcp clawql-mcp-http — default local endpoint http://localhost:8080/mcp (health: /healthz, GraphQL: /graphql). See Deployment.
If you install from git instead of the registry, run npm run build once so dist/ exists (the published npm tarball already includes dist/).
